Symbol: DELHIVERY 
 
Sub: Intimation of Earnings Conference Call of Delhivery Limited ("the Company") 
 
Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the Company will host an 
earnings conference call on Friday, October 30, 2026, at 06:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss its Unaudited 
Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results and developments for the quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026. 
 
Details of the conference call are enclosed. 
 
The above intimation is also being uploaded on the website of the Company at www.delhivery.com. 
 
You are requested to take the same on your record. 
Thank you.  
      
For Delhivery Limited 
 
 
 
Madhulika Rawat 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
Membership No.: F8765 
 
Encl.: As above 
 
 
Madhulika 
Vipin Rawat
